question_text: Define what the name and parameter list specify in a Python function interface.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: The name identifies the callable operation; the parameter list specifies the inputs accepted by that operation.
